model_annotations.English: The plot titled “Veterans as share of population” illustrates how the percentage of veterans in the population changes over time. The x-axis is a linear time axis labeled by decade, ranging from 1960 to 2010 with regularly spaced tick labels at 10-year intervals (1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010). The y-axis is a linear percentage scale with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, and 15 (with “15%” shown at the top), indicating values in percent. A single dark red solid line with open circular markers connects the data points, with numeric labels at each marker: it starts at 12.8% in 1960, rises to 13.8% in 1970, then decreases to 12.1% in 1980, 11.0% in 1990, 9.4% in 2000, and ends at 7% in 2010.
model_annotations.German: The plot titled “Veterans as share of population” illustrates how the veteran share of the population changes over time using a single time-series line. The x-axis is labeled with years on a linear scale, ranging from 1960 to 2010 with regularly spaced decade ticks (1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010). The y-axis shows percentage values on a linear scale from 0 to 15% with major ticks at 0, 5, 10, and 15 (percent sign shown on the top tick). One dark red solid line with open circular markers (white fill) connects the data points and has value labels at each marker: it starts at 12.8% in 1960, rises to 13.8% in 1970, then declines to 12.1% in 1980, 11.0% in 1990, 9.4% in 2000, and ends at 7% in 2010.
